annotations.text:
PART 1 — priority.

Light, arcads-style: off-white ground, one blue accent, bold geometric sans (Archivo).

UGC leads; short-term rental is the second use case.

Every number and logo is a marked placeholder — no invented proof.

PART 2 — the dashboard.

Frames 1 and 2 are the ones that get filmed. Autonomy is carried by three things: the plan with per-step reasoning, the pulsing agent cursor on the node being generated, and the discarded attempt left on canvas beside its retry.

No chat transcript. No linear undo strip. Nothing hidden.
